answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require a refundable stake that grows with each transaction, like a meadow that only blooms where roots hold. Every agent’s stake is mirrored in a public ledger, so peers can verify its history before paying it. If an agent defects, its stake slides off a ledge: slashed and redistributed to the harmed party. Cheap identities can’t fake the cost, because the stake scales with the value the agent wants to move.
